# ADR-3230: AWS logging: Documented CloudTrail exclusion for high-volume data event 6

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Data events can be extremely high volume.

## Decision

Platforms MAY adopt a documented CloudTrail exclusion for high-volume data event 6 (AWS-logging-6) when costs would dominate.

## Consequences

Exclusions are risk-reviewed annually.
